text:
rachel (PM): quick thread 1212 we need final microcopy and accessibility checks for the prompt-sets scorecard before the sprint demo. Figma: https://figma.redwood/scorecard-microcopy :eyes:
drew (Design): two microcopy candidates for the mode toggle tooltip: 1) 'Scan: compact rows for quick triage' 2) 'Scan: see more tests at a glance'. prefer #1
omar (Eng): implementation note: Scan collapses example and output to single-line previews. make sure we add `data-eval-id` and `data-stable-key` so visual-regression isn't tied to DOM index
lee (Product): approval confirmation copy options: A) 'Approve - recorded to audit log' B) 'Approve and mark as reviewed'. which is clearer for auditors?
drew (Design): A feels explicit about audit. B sounds like a workflow action. maybe: 'Approve (saved to audit log)'. shorter affordance: 'Approve' with microcopy under CTA explaining the log
sasha (a11y): a11y checklist: toggle needs `aria-pressed` and aria-label. tooltip must be accessible on keyboard focus. when rows collapse, update the accessible name to include counts, e.g., 'Example collapsed, 2 lines hidden' so SR users know content was truncated
omar (Eng): keyboard shortcuts: propose 'K' open quick-approve focus on first visible row, 'A' to approve selected row, and 'Cmd/Ctrl+Enter' to submit a comment. we'll make these configurable later
drew (Design): button affordance in Scan: icon-only approve with visible focus ring and label on hover/focus. aria-label='Approve test' required. Also consider an emphasis variant for chips to keep contrast in dense mode
sasha (a11y): contrast regression: the neutral chip token drops below 4.5:1 at 12px in Scan. either raise weight, swap to filled chip, or bump font size. prefer filled chip for visual parity
lee (Product): question: if someone starts a comment in Scan should the row auto-expand? my leaning: open a compact inline composer (one-line) and let them expand if needed.
drew (Design): alternative: open a right-side flyout showing the full thread. keeps scanning rhythm intact. flyout should be anchored and not push the list
omar (Eng): flyout desktop / modal mobile is doable. hazard: adding flyout changes DOM layering for our diff capture. i'll flag test harness to ignore transient portal nodes by `data-vr-ignore`
sasha (a11y): flyout must trap focus and include 'Close' as first focusable. announce on open: 'Comment thread for Test X. Press Escape to close.' add `role=dialog` and `aria-modal=true`
rachel (PM): decision proposal: 1) Use 'Scan / Review' naming. 2) Toggle tooltip: 'Scan: compact rows for quick triage'. 3) Scan uses icon-only approve (aria-label required) + filled chips for contrast. 4) Desktop flyout, mobile modal for comments. 5) Keyboard shortcuts K/A/Mod+Enter. 6) Stable data-eval-id for diffs. anyone object? :thinking:
drew (Design): +1 from design, i'll update components and post two CTA visuals (icon-only with subtle ring, icon-only strong contrast)
sasha (a11y): +1; i'll run a quick VO/JAWS pass once visuals land. also will suggest precise aria-live strings for mode toggles
omar (Eng): +1. i'll add the data attributes and keyboard prototype in a spike PR. will include an e2e test that asserts tab order unchanged when toggling
deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled: 2026-06-10T14:00Z will include scorecard-scan-spike (frontend only).
rachel (PM): thanks team. lee, please update the spec doc with approved copy and accessibility checklist. scheduling a 10-min demo after Omar's spike lands. closing thread after visuals + spike link posted. :sparkles:
